name: blueprint-helper
description: Codex-facing BlueprintHelper workflow plugin with mandatory subagents, CLI TaskSpec workflows, and global lifecycle-only MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use mandatory Codex subagents and CLI TaskSpec workflows for UE editor assets.
interface.longDescription: BlueprintHelper routes Codex through a mandatory subagent workflow for Blueprint, UMG, DataAsset, DataTable, Bridge/runtime, preview, execute, compile, save, and diagnostics work. The Main Agent owns preflight and global lifecycle-only MCP tools; blueprint-explorer gathers UE asset context, sourcecode-explorer gathers repository context, and task-worker constructs template-first TaskSpecs through the CLI.
defaultPrompt: Inspect a Blueprint with BlueprintHelper subagents
Configure BlueprintHelper safety profile for Codex
Preview and execute a template-first TaskSpec
